name: A mid-month sale of an owner-occupied unit splits that month between seller and buyer
title: SC-13-03-16 A mid-month sale of an owner-occupied unit splits that month between seller and buyer
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F6
Then the "Kasım 2026" operational principal of "A-4" is 200.00 for "Ahmet Yılmaz" (days 1 to 4)
And 1300.00 for "Gül Tanrıverdi" (days 5 to 30)
And the two shares add up to 1500.00
And "Ahmet Yılmaz" has no active occupancy of "A-4" after "2026-11-05"
